create_XRInput: create an XRInput instance to manage HMD and two XR controller states
get_button_state: check if an XRButton is held, pressed, released, or touched on an XRController
get_thumbstick_axis: get the 2D thumbstick axis values from an XRController instance
get_trigger_values: get the hand or index trigger float values from an XRController
reset_XRInput: reset all XR controller button and continuous input states at the end of a frame
